Case study · Official Hour of AI partner

3.8k kids introduced to AI and coding, nationwide

In 2025, DEVCON Kids brought Hour of AI and micro:bit robotics to public schools across nine chapters, with trained teachers and local volunteers in every room.

2025 to 2026

From Hour of Code to Hour of AI

In 2025, DEVCON Kids moved from Hour of Code to Hour of AI: 3,600+ students reached across 10 chapters, and 100+ teachers and volunteers trained, starting with the national kickoff at the National Science and Technology Week in Laoag.

Hour of AI in 2026

  • Dagupan: Hour of AI at the DOST Region 1 RSTW for 80 learners
  • Mindanao: Hour of AI for teachers on the AI Angat Mindanao Caravan
  • Coming up: DEVCON Kids Hour of AI 2026, with school visits Nov 23–26 and Dec 7–18

About DEVCON Kids

Hour of AI 2026

The season at a glance

From the first school call in September to the awards night in February: two school-visit waves, free training for every teacher and volunteer, and a full impact report.

  • Execution windowsNov 23–26 and Dec 7–18, 2026. Schools pick any date inside these.
  • Free volunteer and teacher trainingNov 14, 21, and 28, open to all teachers and volunteers.
  • Awards nightHour of AI and Chapter Awards Night, Feb 5, 2027.

  1. School contacting

    • Initial outreach sentSep 11–18
    • Follow-up and interest confirmedBy Oct 9
    • Commitments and agreements collectedOct 30
    • Specific-date bookings confirmed (written or MOA)Oct 30

  2. Preparation and training

    • Readiness checkpoint: materials and venueNov 15
    • Logistics arrangedNov 15
    • Internal trainingNov 7
    • Training open to all teachers and volunteersNov 14, 21, 28
    • School readiness check with school officialsNov 15
    • Volunteer readiness check: training and reporting instructionsNov 20

  3. Execution

    • Wave 1 school visitsNov 23–27
    • Wave 1 liquidation and debriefNov 27–28
    • Wave 2 school visitsDec 7–18
    • Wave 2 liquidation and debriefDec 19

  4. Post event

    • Liquidation and report submittedDec 19
    • Impact report completedJan 18, 2027
    • Publish and thank partners weekJan 25, 2027
    • Hour of AI and Chapter Awards NightFeb 5, 2027

The approach

Computer science and AI for every Filipino child

Sessions pair the global Hour of AI curriculum with hands-on micro:bit robotics, taught by trained teachers and DEVCON Kids volunteers, with CPD trainings for educators through CSTA Philippines.

Chapter spotlight

DEVCON Iligan: 980 kids across 7 schools

Iligan ran 8 Hour of AI sessions across 7 schools, reaching 980 learners, plus a Sumo and Soccer Bots Tournament with the local government.

What’s next

10,000 youth in 2027

With Sui’s micro:bit and robotics kit donations and support from partners like DOST and ING, DEVCON Kids aims to empower 10,000 young Filipinos through DEVCON Kids in 2027.
